products.title: Products
products.description: Products compiled into this site — optional ones can be toggled at runtime, no deploy needed. Your data is kept when disabling.
products.enabledDesc: The product is available to every visitor right away — no deploy needed.
products.disabledDesc: The interface disappears for everyone right away. Your data is kept and returns as soon as you switch it back on.
products.toggleFailedDesc: The switch is back to its saved position. Reload the page and try again.
products.toggleBlockedDesc: A product cannot be switched off while another one needs it — and cannot be switched on while its prerequisites are missing. The "Requires: …" line on the cards shows what belongs together.
products.empty: This site is not reporting any products right now. Reload the page — if it stays empty, the product layers are missing from the deploy.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: This instance's access to third-party services. Keys you enter are stored encrypted and never shown again.
integrations.placeholder: Enter a new key — leaving this empty changes nothing
integrations.saveFailedHint: Your input is still in the field. Try again.
integrations.clearText: After this, {env} from the server environment applies again — if nothing is set there, the service is off.
integrations.rotationHint: Shared secret: the same value must exist on both sides. This seam runs one way — enter it HERE on the receiver first (it then accepts both the old and the new value), then on the sender. Nobody notices anything in between. The old value stays valid until it is removed from the server environment.
integrations.rotationHintTwoWay: Shared secret, and this instance does not only accept it — it also SENDS it: to portfolio when a domain is activated. Saving here therefore changes both at once, and portfolio only knows a single valid value from its server environment. That one direction is briefly unavailable until portfolio follows; everything else (creating communities, teams, switching between communities) keeps working. The old value stays valid until it is removed from the server environment.
integrations.notEditable: You can enter keys once NUXT_INSTANCE_SECRETS_KEY is set on the server (openssl rand -hex 32). Until then only the server variables apply.
integrations.emptyText: This instance uses no service whose access could be managed here.
integrations.bootstrapText: These cannot live here: they are needed to reach the encrypted store in the first place.

serviceDesc.ai: Powers moderation assistants and translation suggestions across all communities.
serviceDesc.analytics: Reads visitor numbers for the analytics pages.
serviceDesc.tickets-ai: A separate budget for ticket triage. Without its own key the general AI access applies.
serviceDesc.smtp: Sends notifications, invitations and the daily digest.
serviceDesc.onboarding-service: The shared word this instance and the operator console recognise each other by — creating communities, managing members, activating domains.
serviceDesc.events-sweep: The key a cron job uses to trigger the event reminder sweep.

smtp.passKept: Leaving this empty keeps the stored password.
smtp.clearHint: Clear the server field and save to remove this access — the server environment applies again.

stack.restartHint: The install runs in the background. Wait a moment, then restart the dev server to load the updated versions.
